name: The Immortal Villain
source:
What if Bella never became a vampire and instead died of old age. 

In this story you play as an immortal man with super healing, who never ages or dies. When you find your true love she eventually dies of old age. Every meaningful connection you ever make with anyone always ends in grief. And yet you keep living. 

This visual novel follows your journey to find a way to die. To cease the never ending pain that is life. 

[From [url=https://logrsy.itch.io/the-immortal-villain]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果贝拉从未成为吸血鬼而是因年老而去世怎么办？

在这个故事中，你扮演一个具有超强治愈能力的不朽之人，永远不会衰老或死亡。当你找到真爱时，她最终会因年老而去世。你与任何人建立的每一次有意义的联系总是以悲伤告终。但你还是继续生活。

这部视觉小说讲述了你寻找死亡之道的旅程。停止生命中永无休止的痛苦。

[来自[url=https://logrsy.itch.io/the-immortal-villain]Itch.io[/url]]
